_comment: EPISODE 3, TAKE B of three (4828, 4829, 4830). Answers only: take A asks the question once, at the top, and B and C never do -- that is what fixed episode 1's abrupt joins. Everything that made take A work is carried unchanged: the upright grammar, can_size, guards, plain, pace, and the microphone/street/upright-can all coming from --scene-ref refs/scene/sceneref-4828-t3.5-noface.png rather than from words.

product._state_comment: The sealed grammar is OFF, as it is on take A. Two takes proved the clause does not render (SKILL.md 31) and the `upright` grammar keeps the LID OUT OF SHOT, so the can's state is never on screen. These two keys are the historic wording, back only because the sealed grammar is off; 'nobody opens a' still has to be written by something, and a person opening a can mid-shot is still its own defect.
